propositions: BindingStore embeds multiple lifecycle concerns (forward/reverse transitions, pending/confirmed state, numeric-ID re-key, comment identity, absence grace, tombstones, unretire policy) that should be extracted into a dedicated policy owner
Production rich-text convergence mutates inner dictionaries through shallow all_bindings() call, bypassing any future policy seam and must be redirected through a narrow, supported mutation operation
Lifecycle policy operations must preserve at-most-one identity invariant by targeted single-key reverse pops, never by detecting or refusing ambiguity

Existing BindingStore facade signatures and shallow all_bindings() semantics must remain unchanged for backward compatibility while narrow policy operations become the authoritative production mutation seam

Lifecycle operations must preserve existing failure modes: confirmed 404 grace/reset, moved-key repair, retired corruption fail-open, live corruption fail-closed, append-only comment identity, and tombstone suppression
